A second cosplayer, portraying Lucoa with blonde-green hair and a pink cap, appears standing behind her. The room remains brightly lit with soft shadows against the pale walls. (3) The scene cuts through several sequences featuring Kanna alongside other cosplayers portraying Elma, Tohru, and Ilulu in quick succession. Each character wears their signature anime-accurate costumes and poses in various indoor areas, including near a bookshelf and a sofa, while Kanna continues her rhythmic hand gestures. (4) Kanna is seen sitting on the floor, holding chopsticks and moving them to the beat. Behind her stands a cosplayer dressed as Ilulu, who wears a black and red cape. Kanna then faces the camera, giving a thumbs-up and smiling confidently before the final cut.
